items.prompt:
In a chemical reaction, atoms are
A) rearranged but not created or destroyed
B) destroyed
C) created from nothing
D) turned into energy only
items.answer: A) rearranged but not created or destroyed

items.prompt:
The total mass of reactants equals the total mass of
A) products
B) gas only
C) nothing
D) the container

steps: Mass is conserved, so reactants equal products.

items.prompt:
10 g and 8 g of reactants combine in a sealed container. The products total
A) 2 g
B) 18 g
C) 80 g
D) 0 g

Mass is conserved because
A) atoms are rearranged but not created or destroyed
B) atoms disappear
C) new atoms form
D) mass turns to light
items.answer: A) atoms are rearranged but not created or destroyed

items.prompt:
Reactants total 40 g and one reactant is 15 g. The other reactant is
A) 25 g
B) 55 g
C) 15 g
D) 40 g

In an open container, the mass seems to decrease when a gas forms because
A) the gas escapes
B) mass is destroyed
C) atoms vanish
D) the scale breaks

steps: Escaping gas lowers the measured mass.

items.prompt:
A balanced equation supports conservation of mass because it
A) has the same number of each atom on both sides
B) has different atoms on each side
C) lists prices
D) ignores atoms
items.answer: A) has the same number of each atom on both sides

steps: Equal atoms on both sides means conserved mass.

items.prompt:
A product set totals 50 g and one reactant was 20 g. The other reactant was
A) 30 g
B) 70 g
C) 20 g
D) 50 g

steps: Reactants must total 50 g, and 50 minus 20 is 30.
